description: This repository publishes the org's workflow templates. Every template pins the private reusable workflows to a commit SHA with the release tag as a comment, because zizmor's unpinned-uses audit rejects a bare @main and because a bare SHA without that comment is invisible to Renovate — it cannot tell which tag the pin follows, so the reference would freeze forever.

Renovate's github-actions manager already covers .github/workflow-templates by default; its file pattern names workflow-templates explicitly. No manager configuration is needed here, only the branch and commit conventions the org's repository policy enforces.
The pins were set by hand once, to v0.3.0 of .github-private on 2026-09-09. From here Renovate opens the update PR whenever that repository publishes a new tag.
